title: Ten-year Clinical Experience and Laboratory Validation of the Modified Tube Technique for Removing Fractured Endodontic Instruments using In Vivo Collected Samples
html: Numerous techniques have been proposed for the reliable removal of separated instruments from root canals. In 2015, the modified tube technique (MTT) was introduced, whereby an optical fiber is inserted down to the lumen of a cannula containing composite resin in its tip. The cannula/composite devise is then inserted around the exposed fragment end, entrapping the instrument prior to the light curing of the resin via the optical fiber. This study evaluates the transfer of laboratory findings into clinical practice and vice versa.
